summary: EUDA Health Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K on April 27, 2026, disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq MVLS Notice on April 23, 2026, for failing to maintain a minimum market value of listed securities of $35 million for 32 consecutive business days under Listing Rule 5550(b)(2). No immediate delisting effect; the company has a 180-day compliance period until October 20, 2026, to regain compliance by closing at $35 million or more for ten consecutive business days. Failure may lead to delisting, with potential appeal rights. Watch for any reverse stock split or other actions to boost market cap; risk-arb not applicable as this is a compliance notice.
